headline: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi met a Chinese investor delegation in Peshawar and invited them to invest in the province's natural resources sector, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Governor Kundi ne Peshawar mein Chinese delegation se mulaqat ki

caption:
KP ke maadni wasail mein Chinese investors ko dawat!
Arab News ke mutabiq Governor Faisal Karim Kundi ne Peshawar mein Chinese investors ke delegation se mulaqat ki aur unhein Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke natural resources sector mein sarmaya kari ki dawat di. KP mein minerals, qeemti pathar, marble, granite, chromite, tail aur gas ke zakheere aur hydropower ki salahiyat maujood hai.
Kya is se KP mein rozgar barhega? Comment mein batayein 👇
